mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE >= 9.5%) indicates a weakening labor market and economic slowdown, which typically results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE >= 9.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 340,000) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signal robust consumer demand and favorable financing conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 340000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or interaction term p-value exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle, defined by a 3-month rise in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points, typically leads to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS above 130,000) indicates improving labor market conditions and rising corporate earnings, which consistently produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 500 thousand units signal strong demand for residential construction, boosting economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 500, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A supply contraction, indicated by industrial production below 100 (base 2017=100), reflects reduced manufacturing output and economic slack, typically resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 11,300 billion) combined with moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 220) indicates a healthy economy without overheating, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 11300 and CPIAUCSL < 220, or interaction term p-value exceeds 0.05.
